synth.notes:
Player moves 5 cells per A1-4; hidden walls {(39,5),(34,10)} block entry but still cost 2 budget; entering (9,5) warps to (34,5).
New mechanic (step 134): a move leaving the playfield (board edge or the HUD band starting at the legend/counter top row y=51) is rejected entirely, so no move and no budget spent.
step_bar loses 2 per spent action (x=55-w, tag str(w)). A ring fully covered by the player is consumed and the bar refills to 42.
A target covered by the player is hidden and comes back when uncovered, using memory that only applies when the incoming state matches the last returned one.
Not confirmed: what happens when the bar reaches 0, and whether the bound is the HUD band or only overlap with the legend.
